traits.leaf_shape.note: NZ Flora Astelia (read 2026-10-17): leaves in three ranks, linear to sword-shaped.

traits.sexual_system.note: NZ Flora Astelia (read 2026-10-17): the genus description calls the plants dioecious; neither listed tied state (hermaphrodite, polygamous) fits.

traits.inflorescence.note: NZ Flora Astelia (read 2026-10-17): a terminal panicle whose spathe-subtended branches are each an unbranched raceme.
